issues.explanation: Chapter 120 identifies Sun Xiu’s designated heir as Sun Liang, but the source names the prince as Sun Wan (孙𩃙). Sun Liang was an earlier Wu ruler, so this creates a material succession-identity error immediately after Chapter 119’s account of Sun Xiu’s reign.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace “太子孙亮” with the correct name/transliteration for Sun Xiu’s son, Sun Wan (孙𩃙).
